title: MandateParams
description: Mandate evaluator parameters. SPEC-MANDATE-1: inflation and unemployment targets for the dual/single mandate check.

target_inflation.description: The central bank's inflation target (e.g. 0.02 for 2%).

tolerance_band.description: Symmetric tolerance around target_inflation within which inflation is considered on-target.

mandate_type.description: Whether the mandate is single (inflation only) or dual (inflation + unemployment).

unemployment_target.description: The central bank's unemployment target (e.g. 0.055 for 5.5%).

unemployment_band.description: Symmetric tolerance around unemployment_target within which unemployment is considered on-target.
